title: Tycho-2 fine stellar detail
credit: E. Høg et al. (2000), The Tycho-2 Catalogue, via CDS/VizieR I/259.
processing: ICRS mean positions and measured proper motions, projected into Galactic cube faces. Magnitudes VT 6–13; Hipparcos matches are excluded to avoid duplicating the existing foreground. BT−VT sets approximate stellar colour. Positions of this faint layer are fixed at the stated epoch.
format: Six little-endian bytes per star, sorted by VT per face: u16 u, u16 v, u8 (VT−6)*32, u8 (BT−VT+0.5)*254/3 or 255 for unknown colour.
